iterations.title: Establish the real starting point
iterations.finding: The existing game is an autonomous 2D platformer. Its simulation already covers generation, combat, upgrades, guardians, restart and replay. The visual presentation is the main transformation target.

iterations.checks: Regression reproduced the mismatch, then passed across four tick positions; authoritative checksum unchanged.

iterations.title: Build the cast and the tower in parallel
iterations.finding: Separate builders produced articulated original characters, five tower biomes and a full-screen spectator HUD. The lead is integrating them with the running simulation before independent visual review.
iterations.checks: Character geometry, pose transforms and owned disposal checked; environment geometry and floor lifecycle checked. Integrated visual verdict remains open.

iterations.title: Run the integrated 3D expedition

iterations.checks: Chromium: no page or shader errors; simulation and rendering advance; camera controls work. Host self-test passes authority, privacy, recovery and restart checks. Software GPU render cost remains high.

iterations.title: Improve shapes, action cues and render cost
iterations.finding: Added articulated strikes, recoil and collapse; weathered facade masses, biome ledges and distant citadels; closer follow camera and more readable HUD. A fresh critic inspected four real viewport captures and still preferred the reference. Large geometry and mobile composition need another pass.
iterations.checks: Captured desktop follow/overview and both phone orientations with no page or shader errors. Rigid world batching preserves every triangle and reduces fixture color meshes from roughly 200 to 69–79. Software GPU frame times remain too slow for a performance pass.

iterations.title: Repair continuous-run contracts
iterations.finding: Independent correctness review reproduced rejected intermission snapshots, stale new-run audio, consumed event accumulation, recovery that remained latched, and malformed request handling. Those server-side defects are fixed; browser cache restoration and audio races are being fixed separately.
iterations.checks: Six regression cases failed before their fixes and pass afterward. Moving-platform/action snapshot checks and the stream host authority, privacy, bounded replay, recovery and restart self-test pass.

iterations.title: Rebuild the main forms and reveal the climber
iterations.finding: Replaced the broad cylinder with an asymmetric fortress, framed the current sector, and moved the follow camera toward the climber’s eye line. The fresh critic now finds the desktop hero coherent and readable, while still preferring the reference for world and cast finish. Phone captions and vitals have measured clearance.
iterations.checks: All 73 Tower tests pass. Character batching preserves articulated geometry and reduces the climber from 53 to 10 mesh draws, enemies from 52–54 to 7. Actual desktop/phone captures render without shader errors. Stronger WebGL context-restoration testing exposed a remaining stall; investigation is active.

iterations.title: Repair graphics restoration and client lifecycle
iterations.finding: The independent correctness findings are fixed, including browser-cache restoration, sound races, run-boundary audio reset and lifecycle revisions. A stronger real-WebGL test reproduced invalid old GPU handles after context restoration; resources now retire before the context generation changes.
iterations.checks: Eight independent correctness probes passed. The two strengthened WebGL tests passed after the repair, including repeated context loss, intervening floor changes, preference preservation and zero GL errors. These results precede the later reflection-lighting pass.

iterations.title: Give the Foundry a working industrial identity
iterations.finding: Rebuilt the sector around unequal tapered pylons, a recessed furnace iris, ceramic shells, metal ribs and curved open platform brackets. Finished the cast with rounded armor and articulated poses. The separate critic finds the route clearer, while the commercial reference still wins.
iterations.checks: Structural clearance and real collider-aligned hazard geometry are covered by focused tests. The displayed image is actual game output from an unmodified authoritative tick-118 snapshot held for appearance review; it does not demonstrate live motion.

iterations.checks: The critic retained failed recordings and source hashes. Long frame intervals are no longer discarded by diagnostics. Original stone textures and bounded reflection lighting are being reviewed, and a separate builder is investigating render freshness and pacing.
